title: Open each layer to see the job it does
prompt: Select a layer to reveal what it is responsible for.

hotspots.label: Skills tell the model how to work
hotspots.detail: Skills are reusable packages of instructions, templates, and tools that teach Assistant how to execute specific tasks with domain expertise, and they load only when relevant.

hotspots.label: Actions and MCP give it things to do
hotspots.detail: Actions are tool calls that read from or write to systems. MCP is an open protocol for exposing tools and data to AI apps and agents.

hotspots.label: Agents package it into repeatable workflows
hotspots.detail: Agents are the governed workflow wrapper that packages skills, tools, and knowledge together.
